violations.description: Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned adequately. -Deep clean meat room cutting board. -Clean dishes more thoroughly.
Mechanical cleaning and sanitizing requirements. — --Warewash machine was not maintained and/or operated as required. -Clean dishwasher inside and out.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. -Floors, walls and ceilings need cleaned more thoroughly including in walk ins and in dish pit area.--Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)were not maintained in good repair. -Walls in meat cutting walk in are rusty.

Preventing contamination of packaged and unpackaged food. — --Different species of raw animal food was not properly separated from each other or arranged according to minimum cooking temperatures. -Raw ground meat was stored above whole muscle beef and pork in meat cooler.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. -Floor edges in kitchen and floors in walk in freezer need cleaned.
